description: This file defines the StartupService class, which models the <startup-service> element in the configuration. It reads attributes from an XML element to initialize service properties such as name, runInPool, runtimeDataId, and runtimeDelay, and provides accessor methods for these properties.

classes.name: StartupService
classes.description: A thread-safe immutable class modeling a startup service configuration element, providing access to service configuration attributes.

methods.name: StartupService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the StartupService object based on the XML element provided. It extracts and validates attributes, converting runtime-delay to an integer and handling optional runtime-data-id.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the startup service.

methods.name: getRunInPool
methods.description: Returns whether the service runs in a thread pool.

methods.name: getRuntimeDataId
methods.description: Returns the runtime data ID associated with the service, or null if not specified.

methods.name: getRuntimeDelay
methods.description: Returns the delay before starting the service, in milliseconds.
